newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh elephant puts stamp on PM's party.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh elephant puts stamp on PM's party.

text.p: An elephant waiting to welcome Bangladesh's prime minister at a Hindu festival went berserk on Tuesday in Chittagong port city, injuring three devotees and damaging a shop, witnesses said.
They said the elephant, apparently angered by the pulling of its tail by young enthusiasts, damaged the medicine shop before it could be tamed by its mahut (trainer).
The rampaging animal triggered a security alarm before the Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina had visited the decorated venue of the "Janmashtami" festival, due on Wednesday.
"The welcome ceremony went ahead undisrupted," a police officer told reporters.
